comments.title: Make network owner operations cancellable from Emacs
comments.body: Owner refresh, prepare, publish, and recovery run asynchronously but do not enter the operation wrapper that emits the ID required by K in `magit-auto-review-owner.el:450–452`. A slow or stalled GitHub operation therefore cannot use that cancellation path, while the buffer close guard also refuses termination and directs the user to K. Register these operations with shared cancellation, or provide a safe process-cancellation fallback that preserves uncertain publication intent and releases locks. Backend dispatch was reproduced; actual Emacs cancellation was traced but not executed.

suggestion_generation.reason: The API already handles SIGTERM cooperatively, stops children, preserves uncertain publication intent, and unwinds locks. A fallback targeting the live owned process fixes this in one range. The cancellation branches passed in-memory Emacs checks.

suggestion.original:
(defun magit-auto-review-owner-cancel () "Cancel the owned provider operation." (interactive)
  (unless magit-auto-review-owner--operation (user-error "No cancellable provider operation"))
  (magit-auto-review--call `((command . "cancel") (operation_id . ,magit-auto-review-owner--operation))))
suggestion.replacement:
(defun magit-auto-review-owner-cancel () "Cancel the active owner operation." (interactive)
  (cond
   (magit-auto-review-owner--operation
    (magit-auto-review--call `((command . "cancel") (operation_id . ,magit-auto-review-owner--operation))))
   ((process-live-p magit-auto-review-owner--process)
    (signal-process magit-auto-review-owner--process 'SIGTERM))
   (t (user-error "No owner operation is running"))))
suggestion.head: f5e0321ca179d4c4a434ec456cb404b3cedd7486
